additional_info.subject: Stop Transaction after Error Message
additional_info.body:
Hello Siemens e-mobility Team!
We get invalid charging sessions from multiple SICHARGE stations.
The Problem concerns the duration of the charging sessions.
When a charging session is in progress and the Socket somehow gets the Fault “vendorErrorCode: SECC Status not updated”, then the charging session stops (no further energy transfer), but the charging time is still counting, until a reboot of the charger is done or another customer is trying to start a session. This leads to charging sessions with very long invalid duration.
Can you implement the feature, that the Stop-Transaction will be generated when this kind of error occurs?
Here is a charging session for you to take a closer look at the problem:
300000002003 - Siemens SICHARGE D ERK, 09.02.2026 13:52:05 - 09.02.2026 19:30:37, 6,597 kWh, 5h 38m 31s (fault time:
09.02.2026 14:03:02)
This phenomena happened at different chargers, also refers to case 0465088.
Best Regards,
Florian Mak
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Ihr Ladeinfrastruktur Serviceteam
Phone: +43-316-90555-52156
E-Mail:
lsm@e-netze.at
Website:
www.e-netze.at

additional_info.subject: ID0477784-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/R0300000002003] Charging Station Issue CRM:03289000533
additional_info.body:
Dear
Lara,
Following your request and after our checks, we have identified that the error code encountered during your charging session
“vendorErrorCode: SECC Status not updated”
and that one its  related to the EcoG connection.
We will continue to monitor the charger, and if the issue appears again, we will arrange a site visit to carry out the necessary actions to resolve it.
Regarding your second question about the EcoG connection: we understand your point. The charger waits until the EcoG connection is restored to continue the charging session, which can result in a longer session duration. I will double-check this with the team and get back to you with the confirmed solution.
Thank you for your patience.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

After monitoring the charger for some days, we understand that the issue occurs when the socket reports the fault “vendorErrorCode: SECC Status not updated,” which stops energy transfer but keeps the charging session active, resulting in unusually long session durations. This fault is related to the EcoG connection.
This phenomenon happened at different chargers. To properly investigate the root cause, we recommend e a site check so our field service team can verify the affected stations on-site.
Please share any additional logs or examples you may have, as they will assist the team during the site investigation. We are also waiting for your confirmation to proceed with the site check.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0477784-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/R0300000002003] Charging Station Issue CRM:03289000533
additional_info.body:
Hello Siemens-Support-Team!
Do you really think, an on-site check is sufficient to solve this problem?
This phenomena concerns to different chargers, which indicates a systematic software problem.
To solve this problem, I would suggest a firmware improvement, so the stop transaction is generated if the socket is faulted.
But if an on-site verification helps, you can of course do that.
Here are more examples from other chargers.
Y2 / R0 300000002002, 13.12.2025 11:14:29 - 13.12.2025 14:58:12, 0,225 kWh
FAULT: 11:16:06, SECC Status not updated
MP/S5 170003609, 10.01.2026 15:42:16 - 10.01.2026 20:30:29, 18,194 kWh
FAULT: 16:06:16, SECC Status not updated
MP/R6 170001968, 21.11.2025 09:56:06 - 22.11.2025 22:07:57,
36,335 kWh
Thank you!
B
est regards,
Florian Mak
